title: Check Hospital HMI Default Screen for software version, station IP, and login/logout access
summary: Use the Hospital HMI 2.4 “Default” screen to confirm the currently installed software version, the Hospital Station IP address, and that login/logout controls are available.
when_to_use: When you need to verify the Hospital Station HMI is running the expected software version, that the displayed Hospital Station IP address is correct, and that the user can access login/logout controls from the Hospital HMI “Default” screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the on-screen checks on the Hospital HMI “Default” screen and report any missing/incorrect fields or non-responsive login/logout controls to support/maintenance.
safety_notes: Only maintenance personnel should use the “REBOOT TO SETUP” button (for updating the date/time on the HMI).

access_required: Access to the Hospital HMI / lane UI to reach the “Default” screen
system_preconditions: Hospital HMI is powered on and reachable to display the “Default” screen

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI 2.4 “Default” screen showing software currently installed info, Hospital Station IP address, login/logout controls, and the “REBOOT TO SETUP” button.

steps.title: Open Hospital HMI and navigate to the “Default” screen (Hospital HMI 2.4)
steps.purpose: Reach the screen that displays the software version, Hospital Station IP address, and login/logout controls.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI / lane UI, navigate to the “Default” screen (Hospital HMI 2.4).
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI “Default” screen is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Default” screen is visible and shows the expected sections for software currently installed and Hospital Station IP address, along with login/logout controls.
steps.failure_condition: The “Default” screen does not load, or the expected on-screen sections (software/IP/login/logout) are not present.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Default” screen cannot be reached or does not display the expected information, escalate to support/maintenance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “Default” screen displays information related to the software currently installed and the IP address of the Hospital Station. Users can also log in to and log out from the hospital HMI.

steps.title: Verify software currently installed and Hospital Station IP address
steps.purpose: Confirm the HMI is running the expected software and that the Hospital Station IP address shown on the HMI is correct.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “Default” screen, locate the displayed “software currently installed” information and the Hospital Station IP address, and verify they are present and correct.
steps.expected_result: The “software currently installed” information and the Hospital Station IP address are displayed on the “Default” screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Both the software version and Hospital Station IP address fields are populated with values that are not blank and not obviously incorrect.
steps.failure_condition: The software version or Hospital Station IP address fields are blank, missing, or obviously incorrect.

actions.label: Check software version and IP
actions.exact_action: Locate the displayed “software currently installed” information and record/verify the Hospital Station IP address.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the software version or IP address fields are blank, missing, or obviously incorrect, escalate to support/maintenance for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “Default” screen displays information related to the software currently installed and the IP address of the Hospital Station.

steps.title: Verify login and logout controls are available
steps.purpose: Ensure the user can access login/logout from the Hospital HMI “Default” screen.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “Default” screen, verify that login and logout controls are present and usable (e.g., visible Login/Logout buttons or equivalent controls).
steps.expected_result: Login and logout controls are present on the “Default” screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Login/logout controls are visible and respond as expected for user access management.
steps.failure_condition: Login/logout controls are not present or do not respond.

actions.label: Check login/logout controls
actions.exact_action: Verify the screen provides user login and log out controls (e.g., visible Login/Logout buttons or equivalent controls).

stop_or_escalate_if: If login/logout controls are not present or do not respond, escalate to support/maintenance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Users can also log in to and log out from the hospital HMI.

steps.title: Confirm “REBOOT TO SETUP” is reserved for maintenance personnel
steps.purpose: Prevent unintended maintenance-only actions from the operator check.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “Default” screen, identify the “REBOOT TO SETUP” button and do not use it unless you are maintenance personnel.
steps.expected_result: The “REBOOT TO SETUP” button is visible, and you do not press it as part of this check.
steps.healthy_condition: The button is present but remains unpressed by operator during this verification.
steps.failure_condition: The button is pressed by non-maintenance personnel or the operator attempts to use it during this check.

actions.label: Locate REBOOT TO SETUP
actions.exact_action: Do not use the “REBOOT TO SETUP” button unless you are maintenance personnel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “REBOOT TO SETUP” button was pressed by non-maintenance personnel, escalate to support/maintenance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Only maintenance personnel should use the REBOOT TO SETUP button if they need to update the date or time on the HMI.

success_criteria: Hospital HMI “Default” screen shows software currently installed information
Hospital HMI “Default” screen shows Hospital Station IP address
Login/logout controls are present and usable
“REBOOT TO SETUP” is not used by operator during this check
healthy_conditions: Software version and Hospital Station IP address fields are populated and not blank/obviously incorrect
Login/logout controls are visible and respond
“REBOOT TO SETUP” remains unpressed by operator
failure_conditions: Software version field is blank/missing or obviously incorrect
Hospital Station IP address field is blank/missing or obviously incorrect
Login/logout controls are missing or do not respond
“REBOOT TO SETUP” is used by non-maintenance personnel
escalation_guidance: If software version or IP address are blank/missing/obviously incorrect, escalate to support/maintenance for further investigation.
If login/logout controls are missing or do not respond, escalate to support/maintenance.
If “REBOOT TO SETUP” was pressed by non-maintenance personnel, escalate to support/maintenance.
